title: Save shows a settings toast
summary: Clicking Save shows a toast reading "Settings saved" that stays for 4 seconds and then fades.
what_differs: The broken page sets the toast text but never makes the toast visible, so clicking Save shows nothing.

wordings.text: Verify a toast message "Settings saved" appears.
Verify that within 3 seconds of clicking Save, a message with the exact text "Settings saved" is visible.
